summary: ECB Executive Board Member Philip Lane delivered a speech on October 21, 2025, explaining the ECB's framework for assessing monetary policy transmission, including the introduction of a new Macro-Finance Financial Conditions Index (FCI). The speech detailed the ECB's rate path since July 2022 (from -50 bps to 400 bps), the easing cycle from June 2024 to June 2025 (200 bps cumulative cut), and that policy rates have remained unchanged since June 2025. The Macro-Finance FCI remains above its historical average, indicating conditions are less restrictive than peak tightening but not back to pre-pandemic norms.
